title: FizzBuzz
solution: public class FizzBuzz { public static void main(String[] args) { for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) { if (i % 15 == 0) System.out.println("FizzBuzz"); else if (i % 3 == 0) System.out.println("Fizz"); else if (i % 5 == 0) System.out.println("Buzz"); else System.out.println(i); } } }

title: Palindrome Checker
description: Check if a text is palindrome.
solution: public class PalindromeChecker { public static boolean isPalindrome(String text) { String clean = text.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "").toLowerCase(); return clean.equals(new StringBuilder(clean).reverse().toString()); } }
